title: Index Maintenance API + Persisted Job Plumbing (No UI)
repo_context: Expose multi-pool index maintenance via FastAPI endpoints and a file-backed job store so maintenance can be executed and polled deterministically.

stories.title: Add file-backed IndexMaintenanceJobStore (mirrors ImageToTextJobStore patterns) + models + deterministic tests
acceptance_criteria: IndexMaintenanceJobStore persists one JSON file per job under dossiers_processing_jobs_root("index_maintenance") and maintains an index file mapping job_id -> filename
Job record includes required fields: request, computed identity, timestamps, status, progress, results
A deterministic pytest verifies create -> update -> reload roundtrip produces identical job state
stories.notes: Reuse patterns from backend/services/image_queue/job_store.py; keep it lightweight and deterministic.

stories.title: Server-side RuntimeIndexIdentity helper for /api/index (compute fingerprint + policy id; deterministic UNAVAILABLE on failure) + tests
acceptance_criteria: A helper computes RuntimeIndexIdentity server-side using resolve_embedding_model(AssetsService()) and compute_model_fingerprint(model_info)
Chunking policy id is explicit and matches v0 decision: FINAL_SEGMENTS and EVERYTHING both use FINAL_SEGMENTS_POLICY.policy_id
If identity cannot be computed (e.g. missing model info), API surfaces return UNAVAILABLE deterministically without throwing
A deterministic pytest covers identity computation failure -> UNAVAILABLE response shape (no stack traces)
stories.notes: Frontend never supplies identity. Keep exception details minimal (exception_type only).

stories.title: Add GET /api/index/diagnose endpoint mounted at /api/index (stable report + counts + caps) + deterministic tests
acceptance_criteria: New FastAPI router exists at backend/api/endpoints/index_maintenance.py and is mounted in backend/api/router.py under prefix /api/index
GET /api/index/diagnose calls PoolMaintenanceController.diagnose_pool(...) using server-computed runtime identity
Response always includes pool_open; includes pool_health only when open OK; includes slice_diagnoses only when include_slices=true (capped by limit_slices server max)
Response includes derived counts: healthy/missing/stale/unavailable
Endpoint never throws: unexpected failure returns pool_open UNAVAILABLE with reason_code UNAVAILABLE_UNKNOWN and detail=<exception_type>
Deterministic pytest verifies stable no-throw fallback behavior and slice limiting
stories.notes: Enforce server cap on limit_slices (e.g. max 1000) to prevent huge payloads.

stories.title: Add POST /api/index/execute: enqueue job, deterministic slice selection, background execution, persisted progress + tests
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/index/execute accepts body {pool_identifier, mode, limit, dossier_id?, dry_run} and returns a job_id
Endpoint computes runtime identity server-side; safe_open_pool is used first and UNAVAILABLE is handled deterministically (job records UNAVAILABLE or stable error response)
Slice selection is deterministic: filtered by mode, sorted by (dossier_id, entry_id), hard-limited and server-max-limited
Execution runs in background task and updates the persisted job record slice-by-slice (progress counts + results)
Deterministic pytest verifies selection ordering + limit enforcement and that job record is created with expected fields
stories.notes: Prefer non-HNSW stubs in tests; job execution can be validated with stub executor/controller.

stories.title: Add GET /api/index/jobs/{job_id}: return persisted job record (with optional result capping) + tests
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/index/jobs/{job_id} returns a stable job record shape from IndexMaintenanceJobStore
Nonexistent job_id returns 404 with deterministic error payload
A deterministic pytest verifies job fetch returns persisted state and 404 behavior
stories.notes: If you cap returned results, document the cap and ensure stored results remain complete.

stories.title: Optional: typed frontend API wrapper (no UI) for diagnose/execute/getJob
acceptance_criteria: frontend/src/lib/indexMaintenanceApi.ts exports diagnoseIndex(params), executeIndex(body), getIndexJob(jobId)
No React components or UI wiring is added
stories.notes: Keep it minimal; reuse existing frontend fetch helpers if present.
